item.title: Queen of Grapes #479 - DND Gel Duo
item.description: Queen of Grape #479 – The perfect shimerry purple Matching Gel Polish and Varnish. Following a professional 3 step gel system: DND Gel Polishes needs to be cured under a LED lamp, used with the DND Base Gel and DND Top Gel. Matching nail lacquers need to air dry.1. Starting with completely clean and prepped nails, apply a single coat of DND base gel and cure for 30 seconds in a LED lamp2. Apply a single thin layer of gel color and cure for 30-45 seconds in a LED lamp3. Apply the second thin layer of gel color and cure for 30-45 seconds in a LED lamp4. Apply DND top coat no cleanse and cure for 30 seconds in a LED lamp5. Applying thick layers of gel color can result in an uneven cure leading to chipping and peeling. Make sure to hydrate daily by moisturizing the cuticles. IngredientsBis-HEM

item.title: Handmade Autumn Press On Nails, Pumpkin Maple Leaf Nail Art
item.description: 📦 What's Included ✔ Full set of10 custom-sized press-on nails ✔ Nail glue, adhesive tabs, mini file, alcohol wipe & cuticle stick Please note: Orders outside the US do not include glue. ✨ Features - 100% Handmade - Lightweight & flexible for comfort -Easy to apply & remove - Long-lasting & reusable - Waterproof 📏 How to Measure Your Sizes - Place a piece of clear tape over your nail. - Trace both sides of your nail with a marker. - Measure the widest part of your nail and match it with the sizing chart. 💅 How to Apply (Adhesive Tabs Method) - Gently push back cuticles with the wooden stick. - (Optional) Lightly file nail surface for better adhesion. Remove oil & moisture. - Select an adhesive tab slightly smaller than your nail, press it on, smooth edges, then peel off the film. - Align
